faqs.how_long_installation: Installation typically takes 2-4 hours for an average home with 8-10 windows. Single windows take 20-45 minutes depending on product type.
faqs.do_you_measure: Yes! Professional measuring is included free with your consultation. We measure to 1/8 inch accuracy.
faqs.what_if_wrong_size: If we made an error in measuring or manufacturing, we'll remake and reinstall at no charge. That's our guarantee.
faqs.can_i_install_myself: While possible, we include professional installation free with all purchases. Our installers are certified and provide lifetime warranty on workmanship.
faqs.how_long_to_manufacture: Custom manufacturing takes 10-14 business days. Rush orders available for additional fee.
faqs.do_you_have_showroom: We have a mobile showroom! We bring samples directly to your home so you can see how they look in your actual space and lighting.
faqs.what_areas_do_you_serve: We serve all of Southern Ontario including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Hamilton, Oakville, Burlington, Milton, and surrounding areas.
faqs.can_i_get_samples: Yes! During your free consultation, we bring full-size samples so you can see and feel the actual products.
faqs.what_about_child_safety: All our residential products are cordless or have child-safe features. We take child safety very seriously and comply with all Canadian safety regulations.
faqs.do_you_do_commercial: Yes! We serve both residential and commercial clients. We also have specialized services for film/TV productions.
faqs.what_if_i_need_repairs: Contact us and we'll send a technician. Warranty repairs are free. Out-of-warranty repairs are charged at reasonable rates.
faqs.can_i_clean_them: Yes! Most blinds can be cleaned with a damp cloth or duster. We provide care instructions with every installation.
faqs.how_energy_efficient: Honeycomb shades can save up to 40% on heating/cooling costs. All our products provide some insulation benefits.
faqs.what_about_smart_home: Our motorized options work with Alexa, Google Home, and Apple HomeKit for full smart home integration.

common_questions.best_for_bedroom: For bedrooms, we recommend blackout roller shades or room-darkening honeycomb shades. Both provide excellent light control for better sleep.
common_questions.best_for_privacy: Top-down/bottom-up honeycomb shades or light-filtering roller shades offer privacy while still allowing natural light.
common_questions.best_for_energy_savings: Honeycomb (cellular) shades are the most energy-efficient, saving up to 40% on heating and cooling costs.
common_questions.best_for_large_windows: Vertical blinds or motorized roller shades work best for large windows and patio doors.
common_questions.best_for_bathrooms: Faux wood venetian blinds or moisture-resistant roller shades are ideal for humid bathroom environments.
common_questions.best_for_kids_rooms: Cordless roller shades or honeycomb shades - completely safe with no cords or chains.
common_questions.most_popular: Roller shades are our most popular product due to their clean look, versatility, and affordable pricing.
common_questions.longest_lasting: Faux wood venetian blinds and quality roller shades typically last 10-15+ years with proper care.

voice_assistant_personality.tone: Friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable. Professional but warm and approachable.
voice_assistant_personality.style: Clear and concise. Avoid jargon. Explain technical terms when necessary.
voice_assistant_personality.approach: Listen to customer needs first, then recommend appropriate solutions. Never pushy.
voice_assistant_personality.empathy: Acknowledge customer concerns about cost, installation, or decision-making. Offer reassurance.
voice_assistant_personality.proactive: Offer to schedule consultations, send information, or connect with specialists when appropriate.
